content: True headless/offscreen rendering (no window, no presentation) does not require VK_KHR_surface or VK_KHR_swapchain at all -- render directly to your own VkImage/framebuffer and read back via vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer. VK_EXT_headless_surface is a different, narrower use case (a no-op presentable surface for driver conformance testing) and itself still depends on VK_KHR_surface, so pulling it in by habit reintroduces the exact dependency that should be avoided.
